title: Zesty Charred Thai Red Onion Noodles
description: Charred red onions, crisp vegetables, and al-dente noodles tossed in a zesty Thai sauce, perfect for meal prep on a robata grill.
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for 15 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside.
Combine soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, chili paste, grated ginger, minced garlic, and coconut milk in a bowl to make the sauce.
Preheat the robata grill to medium-high and brush it lightly with sesame oil.
Place the sliced red onions, carrot matchsticks, and bell pepper strips on the grill and char them for 2-3 minutes on each side, flipping until they develop dark charred edges.
Toss the charred vegetables with the prepared sauce until they are evenly coated.
Add the drained vermicelli to the pan and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until the noodles are al dente and have absorbed the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a bowl, garnish with chopped cilantro and fresh lime wedges, and serve immediately.
For meal prep, divide the noodles into 4 airtight containers and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
